filesystem.description: Read/write vault and project files. Scoped to project directory for security.

context7.description: Fetch latest documentation for frameworks, libraries, and APIs. Used by Better Auth Guardian, Next.js Frontend Architect, and all agents requiring up-to-date API references.

email-mcp.description: Gmail integration: send, draft, search, and read emails. Used by Communication Agent. Requires OAuth credentials in environment.

browser-mcp.description: Browser automation: navigate, click, fill forms, take screenshots. Used by Social Media Agent for platform interaction and Finance Agent for payment portals.

calendar-mcp.description: Google Calendar integration: create, update, delete, and list events. Used by Communication Agent for scheduling and Monitoring Agent for deadline tracking.

slack-mcp.description: Slack integration: send messages, read channels, manage threads. Used by Communication Agent for team communication.

odoo-mcp.description: Odoo 19+ JSON-RPC integration: invoices, expenses, journal entries, financial reports. Used by Finance Agent for accounting operations.
